**- Q3 revenue accelerated 39% sequentially and exceeded the upper end of the Company’s revenue expectations by 39% –**


**- Gross profit delivers a remarkable US$11 million quarterly turnaround, with gross margin rebounding 17 percentage points to 12.8% as Gorilla gains operating scale –**


**- Gorilla deployed approximately US$218 million into infrastructure and equipment in Q3, building the foundation for its next phase of global AI compute and data centre expansion –**


**- With record quarterly revenue and accelerating infrastructure development, Gorilla reaffirms its FY2026 revenue outlook of at least US$200 million and its US$450 million to US$500 million target for 2027 –**


London, United Kingdom–(Newsfile Corp. – November 19, 2026) – Gorilla Technology Group Inc. (NASDAQ: GRRR) (“Gorilla” or the “Company”), a global solution provider in Security Intelligence, Network Intelligence, Business Intelligence, IoT technology and data centres, today announced its preliminary unaudited and unreviewed financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026.


Gorilla delivered record quarterly revenue of approximately **US$69.5 million** , representing an increase of **162.6% year on year** and **38.7% sequentially** , as the Company continued to execute its AI infrastructure and technology programmes.


Third quarter revenue significantly surpassed the Company’s previously announced planning range of US$48 million to US$50 million, exceeding its upper end by approximately 39%. This was driven by increased customer deliveries of AI infrastructure.


The quarter also marked a meaningful recovery in gross profitability. Gross profit reached approximately US$8.9 million compared with a gross loss of US$2.1 million in the preceding quarter, representing an improvement of approximately US$11.0 million.


Gross margin recovered to 12.8% from negative 4.2% in Q2 2026, an improvement of approximately 17 percentage points.


The results demonstrate the acceleration of Gorilla’s revenue base and the Company’s increasing scale in AI infrastructure and data centre technology. Gorilla continues to invest in equipment, infrastructure and operational capabilities intended to support its long-term growth ambitions.


**Financial highlights**


-


**Record Q3 revenue surges 162.6% year on year:** Revenue reached approximately US$69.5 million, compared with US$26.5 million in Q3 2025, representing an increase of approximately US$43.0 million.


-


**Strong sequential revenue growth:** Revenue increased 38.7% from US$50.1 million in Q2 2026, reflecting continued acceleration in the scale of the Company’s delivery activities.


-


**Significant outperformance against guidance:** Q3 revenue exceeded the upper end of the Company’s previously announced US$48 million to US$50 million planning range by approximately 39%.


-


**Gross profit rebounds by US$11 million:** Gross profit improved from a gross loss of US$2.1 million in Q2 2026 to a gross profit of approximately US$8.9 million in Q3 2026.


-


**Gross margin recovers sharply:** Gross margin increased from negative 4.2% in Q2 to positive 12.8% in Q3, an improvement of approximately 17 percentage points. The improvement represents a meaningful sequential recovery.


-


**Substantial investment in AI infrastructure:** Gorilla deployed approximately US$218.0 million of cash for property and equipment during Q3 2026, supporting its ongoing AI infrastructure development programme.


-


**Expanded infrastructure asset base:** Property and equipment, including capital work in progress, reached approximately US$248.9 million at September 30, 2026, compared with US$29.4 million at June 30, 2026. These investments are primarily in fixed assets for deploying the Yotta 1 contract.


-


**Financing supports deployment:** Net cash generated from financing activities was approximately US$119.2 million in Q3 2026. The Company ended the quarter with approximately US$56.5 million in cash, following substantial infrastructure investment of $218.0 million and an operating cash use of US$30.2 million.

**Statement from Jay Chandan, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer**


“Gorilla has entered an entirely different league. In just twelve months, we have grown quarterly revenue from US$26.5 million to US$69.5 million, an extraordinary 163% increase. Revenue accelerated nearly 39% sequentially and exceeded the upper end of our expectations by 39%. We are no longer talking about potential. We are demonstrating our ability to deliver at scale,” said Jay Chandan, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.


“Equally significant is the transformation in our gross profitability. In a single quarter, we delivered US$11 million improvement in gross profit, moving from a gross loss of US$2.1 million in Q2 2026 to a gross profit of US$8.9 million in Q3 2026, with gross margin recovering by 17 percentage points. This is powerful evidence of the progress we are making as our business expands.


What investors are witnessing is the emergence of a significantly larger Gorilla. During the quarter, we deployed approximately US$218 million of cash into infrastructure and equipment, building the physical and technological foundation for our next phase of growth. These investments are designed to support substantial AI computing demand and long-term customer relationships. Our focus now is to convert that infrastructure into productive capacity, higher utilisation, stronger margins and sustainable cash generation.


Our revenue ambition for 2027 remains in the range of US$450 million to US$500 million. Achieving that target will require disciplined execution, and our third quarter performance demonstrates the scale at which Gorilla can now operate.


We have spent years building the capabilities and now we are delivering the scale. The next chapter is about turning that scale into lasting profitability, cash generation and shareholder value. We believe the most significant opportunities for Gorilla are still ahead.”


**Statement from Bruce Bower, Chief Financial Officer**


**“Gorilla’s third quarter results demonstrate the extraordinary pace at which our business is scaling.** Revenue surged 163% year on year to US$69.5 million. Gross profitability improved by approximately US$11 million sequentially, a recovery by 17 percentage points to 12.8%, reflecting meaningful progress as we expand our operating scale,” said Bruce Bower, Chief Financial Officer.


**“This growth is being supported by one of the most significant infrastructure investment periods in Gorilla’s history.** During the quarter, we deployed approximately US$218 million of cash into property and equipment, substantially expanding the asset base needed to support our AI infrastructure business.


Our Q3 2026 preliminary IFRS operating loss was US$9.9 million, with a net loss of US$16.6 million and an adjusted EBITDA loss of US$6.2 million. These results reflect the costs and financial demands of expanding a capital intensive business.


We closed the quarter with US$56.5 million in cash, following US$119.2 million of net financing inflows and an operating cash use of US$30.2 million.


**Our financial priorities are clear: disciplined capital deployment, stronger customer collections, improving margins and converting infrastructure investment into sustainable cash generation.**


We are building the financial and operational foundations for a significantly larger business. **The next phase is about translating our growing revenue base and infrastructure assets into stronger operating performance, higher margins, improved capital efficiency and enduring shareholder value.”**


**Priorities for the Remainder of 2026 and into 2027**


Gorilla’s immediate priorities are to:


- Accelerate the commissioning and operational readiness of infrastructure under existing programmes.
- Increase utilisation and support the migration of customer workloads onto deployed infrastructure.
- Improve gross margins through a stronger revenue mix and higher utilisation.
- Strengthen customer billing, receivables collection and operating cash conversion.
- Maintain financial discipline across capital expenditure, project financing and operational commitments.
- Expand international infrastructure opportunities where commercial demand and project economics support investment.


These priorities are intended to support the Company’s progression towards a larger base of productive infrastructure and recurring revenue.

**About Gorilla Technology Group Inc.**


Headquartered in London U.K., Gorilla is a global solution provider in Security Intelligence, Network Intelligence, Business Intelligence, IoT technology and data centres. We provide a wide range of solutions, including Smart City, Network, Video, Security Convergence and IoT, across select verticals of Government and Public Services, Manufacturing, Telecom, Retail, Transportation and Logistics, Healthcare and Education, by using AI and Deep Learning Technologies.


Our expertise lies in revolutionizing urban operations, bolstering security and enhancing resilience. We deliver pioneering products that harness the power of AI in intelligent video surveillance, facial recognition, license plate recognition, edge computing, post-event analytics and advanced cybersecurity technologies. By integrating these AI-driven technologies, we empower Smart Cities to enhance efficiency, safety and cybersecurity measures, ultimately improving the quality of life for residents.
